tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm archival cream in light; charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Rule panels, quoted field notes, the disclosure box. Never a second page ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on paper and paper-raised (14:1 and above in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, file references, captions on paper and paper-raised (5.7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between rules and sections only. Never the only thing separating a control.

tokens.name: international-orange
tokens.usage: The brand fill: the Agent Running wordmark, rule numerals, cover blocks. As text only at 24px and above (4.8:1 on light paper, 3.1:1 on dark). Smaller orange text uses orange-text.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange text under 24px: rule labels, the 'Rule' eyebrow, active navigation. On paper and paper-raised (5.3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text set on an international-orange fill (5.2:1).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Piper's own colour, after her Royal Navy years: the P.S. mark fill and cover blocks. Lightened in dark so it stays visible on charcoal.

tokens.name: navy-text
tokens.usage: The P.S. signature, links, and the focus ring. On paper and paper-raised (7.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text set on a navy fill, such as the letters inside the P.S. mark (6.5:1 or better).

families.display: "Libre Caslon Display", "Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and piece titles, in ink.

styles.name: rule-numeral
styles.usage: The large number beside each rule, in international-orange.

styles.name: rule-title
styles.sample: Keep the purse outside the operation.
styles.usage: A rule's imperative headline, in ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Telling the agent to watch the budget is insufficient.
styles.usage: All running text, in ink, about 65 characters a line.

styles.name: closing-line
styles.sample: The agent can pursue the result. It cannot increase the stake.
styles.usage: The last line of a rule, the one that sticks. One per rule, in ink.

styles.name: signature
styles.usage: Piper's sign-off at the end of a piece, in navy-text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and rule labels, in orange-text or ink-muted.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, field-report references, operational figures, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and the line it labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside the P.S. mark and meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside rule panels; gap between numeral and rule text.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between one rule and the next.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections and under the masthead.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default: panels, blocks, the masthead rule. Plain covers, square corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and form fields, just enough to read as controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The P.S. mark only.
